newsitem.title: USA: Ecogen sees Q4 hurt by equipment flaws.
newsitem.headline: Ecogen sees Q4 hurt by equipment flaws.

text.p: Ecogen Inc said on Thursday that design problems with its pesticide-making equipment would hold back the company's product sales and earnings.
The company said it would not meet its estimate to break even in the 1996 fiscal year ending October 31.
Shortages of the water-dispersible granule form of its pesticides will also lead to lower fourth-quarter sales and gross margins than in the year-ago period.

In the fiscal year ended October 1995, the agricultural biotechnology company reported a loss of $23.3 million, or $0.87 a share, including a charge. The loss without the charge would have been $0.49 a share.
Ecogen posted a 1995 fourth-quarter loss of $5.2 million, or $0.15 a share, including a charge.
